# Finding repros (complete index)

## User-mode (flat) — runnable minimal repros
Each is the single instruction that halts/diverges, isolated. Build with
`gcc -m32 -nostdlib -static -Wl,-Ttext=0x08048000` and run the core TB.

* **bt_mem** — BT  Ev,Gv  with a memory operand HALTs (reg-direct works)
  ```
  btl   %eax, (%esi)
  ```
* **bts_mem** — BTS Ev,Gv  memory HALTs
  ```
  btsl  %eax, (%esi)
  ```
* **btr_mem** — BTR Ev,Gv  memory HALTs
  ```
  btrl  %eax, (%esi)
  ```
* **btc_mem** — BTC Ev,Gv  memory HALTs
  ```
  btcl  %eax, (%esi)
  ```
* **bt_imm_mem** — BT  Ev,Ib  memory HALTs
  ```
  btl   $1, (%esi)
  ```
* **shld_mem** — SHLD Ev,Gv,Ib memory HALTs (reg-direct works)
  ```
  shldl $4, %eax, (%esi)
  ```
* **shrd_mem** — SHRD Ev,Gv,Ib memory HALTs
  ```
  shrdl $4, %eax, (%esi)
  ```
* **pop_es** — POP ES HALTs (segment POP gap)
  ```
  pushl %eax
  pop   %es
  ```
* **pop_ss** — POP SS HALTs
  ```
  pushl %eax
  pop   %ss
  ```
* **pop_ds** — POP DS HALTs
  ```
  pushl %eax
  pop   %ds
  ```
* **pop_gs** — POP GS HALTs (0F A9)
  ```
  pushl %eax
  pop   %gs
  ```
* **fsin** — FSIN deferred->HALT without VEN_TRANSCENDENTAL
  ```
  finit
  fldpi
  fsin
  ```
* **fcos** — FCOS deferred->HALT
  ```
  finit
  fld1
  fcos
  ```
* **f2xm1** — F2XM1 deferred->HALT
  ```
  finit
  fldz
  f2xm1
  ```
* **fptan** — FPTAN deferred->HALT
  ```
  finit
  fld1
  fptan
  ```
* **fsin_inf** — FSIN of +inf HALTs (feature build): IEEE special-input gap — should set C2+return NaN, not halt
  ```
  finit
  fldl 1f
  fsin
  jmp 2f
  .align 8
  1:  .quad 0x7FF0000000000000
  2:
  ```
* **fxtract** — FXTRACT HALTs even WITH +VEN_TRANSCENDENTAL (genuine gap; it is an exact exponent/mantissa split, not an approximation)
  ```
  finit
  fldpi
  fxtract
  ```
* **mov_moffs** — MOV moffs (A0) not decoded -> HALT (raw bytes A0+disp32)
  ```
  .byte 0xa0, 0x00, 0x00, 0x04, 0x08
  ```

## Real/Protected-mode findings — repro via the mode stream
Add the instruction back to the named image (`gen_modes.py`) and run
`run-modes.sh`; the core halts at that instruction vs qemu-system.

* **clts** — CLTS (0F 06) HALTs — vehicle `modes/realmode_priv` — `clts`
* **lmsw** — LMSW (0F 01 /6) HALTs — vehicle `modes/realmode_priv` — `smsww %ax; lmsw %ax`
* **invlpg** — INVLPG (0F 01 /7) HALTs — vehicle `modes/realmode_priv` — `invlpg 0x600`
* **lar** — LAR (0F 02) HALTs (PM only) — vehicle `modes/pm32_cpl0` — `lar %ax, %ebx`
* **lsl** — LSL (0F 03) HALTs (PM only) — vehicle `modes/pm32_cpl0` — `lsl %ax, %ebx`
* **verr** — VERR (0F 00 /4) HALTs (PM) — vehicle `modes/pm32_cpl0` — `verr %ax`
* **verw** — VERW (0F 00 /5) HALTs (PM) — vehicle `modes/pm32_cpl0` — `verw %ax`
* **sldt** — SLDT (0F 00 /0) HALTs (PM) — vehicle `modes/pm32_cpl0` — `sldt %dx`
* **str** — STR (0F 00 /1) HALTs (PM) — vehicle `modes/pm32_cpl0` — `str %bp`
